knowledge.plain_language_summary: A faux-material monument: two ACM-wrapped wood posts on a faux brick/stone planter base carrying a routed/carved faux-woodgrain HDU sign panel, a dimensional logo, a magnetic changeable steel message panel, and ACM tenant panels. Customer-supplied solar uplight.
knowledge.rationale: A heavy faux-material program (faux wood HDU, faux brick) plus a magnetic changeable panel and solar uplight gives a low-electrical, serviceable tenant monument.

structure.construction: two 6x6 wood posts wrapped in 3mm black ACM with flat caps; fabricated aluminum angle planter frame + basin, sheathed in TexturePlus faux brick/stone
2in HDU routed/carved faux-woodgrain with faux bands + rivet heads, painted faux-wood, on 2x2 aluminum tube rails; dimensional logo flush-mounted
2x2 aluminum rails + 1/16in steel faces satin black with changeable magnetic message inserts
customer-supplied solar light kit on bracket

materials_manifest.product: TexturePlus Antique Select Old World faux brick + Coral Block Ledgers

craft_observations: Magnetic changeable message panel is serviceable/reusable.
Heavy faux-material program (HDU faux wood + faux brick).
